title: Smoky Korean Pork Belly
description: A sweet and spicy Korean-inspired dish with crispy pork belly, perfect for keto diets.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together adventurous sauce, smoky gochujang, and 2 tbsp of oil.
Add pork belly to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange pork belly in a single layer.
Roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes or until crispy.
Meanwhile, cook namul according to package instructions.
To serve, place crispy pork belly on a plate and top with namul.
Garnish with black sesame seeds and serve immediately.
